rationale: Closed tabletop negative supervision was present for all18AB roots and actually sampled. Frozen labels and tested object bindings match. One training seed cannot identify seed variance; checkpoint dependence and C normal-state errors remain a generalization/optimization issue, not a proven coverage-only cause. A live-falling coverage gap exists but does not explain the targeted closed-tabletop false completion. Do not start another batch to chase zero C errors.
remaining_choice: A broader preregistered comparison of scene/layout diversity, constrained readout/calibration, and seed robustness needs a new primary objective and independent evaluation budget. Plan action negatives and state sufficiency remain separate blockers.
